proposals.value: The corpus frames the 2026 US-Israel-Iran war as a structural break: military analysis (cluster-122, cluster-125) treats direct strikes as ending decades of deterrence assumptions, while diplomatic coverage (cluster-124, cluster-140) questions whether any negotiation framework or nuclear containment model survives the escalation.
